posts.author: KiZai
posts.title: Judge: Squads
posts.edited: Last Edit: September 04, 2009, 02:04:24 AM by KiZai
posts.html:
The system of squads of 5 is the number 5 for a reason. There are 5 items in each shipment; organising groups of 5 ensures that everyone within judge will attain the high level items.

Squads live separately, but members of each squad will live together, e.g. squad 1 living together but not with squad 2. How you choose to manage how each squad operates (e.g. who goes to the streets, who stays at base etc) but you should never travel on your own. We currently need to maintain a low profile until we get better resources in order to stand alongside the current factions.

When that time comes, squads will be assigned different duties and areas of patrol by myself, until then it is merely to assist members in getting the better items, and to keep you as safe as possible.

All squads will share a radio frequency, and can come to each others aid whenever needed.

The initial squads are as follows:

Squad 1, Dusk:
  • KiZai, Zack Aiyre
  • Ruxandra-{TRF}-, Ashley Shephard
  • Mole, Craig Hemingway
  • Shoulerboy, Jason "shadow" Skylian
  • Crackshotkeg, Jason Hawk

Squad 2, Dawn
  • Chronic, George Hamton
  • {EvO}-'Thorium{TRF}, Sanches Muchas
  • ||VM:RP|| The Joker, Ty James
  • Justincase, Justin Orndorff
  • JM42, Mark Kellerman

Reserves:

I thought it best to split Ruxandra and Chronic, because forcing them into a squad may cause unnecessary strain, and I also paired Chronic with Thorium as they know each other in real life. If there are any issues with the current squads, post here or /pm me if you wish it to be confidential.

If anyone becomes inactive within a squad, post here and you shall have a new member placed into your squad, and the inactive member shall be put on reserve. Add each other on steam, get to know each other, you will work best together this way.

-KiZai
